name: BrowserUse
summary: Hand a browsing task to an AI agent
description:
Describe what you need done on the web and a browser-use agent carries it out in Chrome on this Mac. Each action you add in KeepTalking can be limited to a list of domains, and every run comes back with a signed usage receipt.

Real runs need an LLM provider and API key below; until then the plugin answers with a mock run that says what it would have done.

meters.name: browser.seconds
meters.description: Wall-clock seconds of browser agent time

config.label: LLM provider
config.description: Which provider drives the browser agent; 'openai-compatible' means set an endpoint below

config.label: LLM API key
config.description: Stored in the plugin's state dir (0600); env var works too

config.label: Endpoint URL
config.description: Base URL for OpenRouter, a gateway, or a local OpenAI-compatible server. Blank uses the provider's own endpoint

config.label: Model
config.description: Blank uses the provider default (required for openai-compatible)

config.label: Force mock runs
config.description: Never launch a real browser, even when configured

kinds.name: browser-task
kinds.description: Run a natural-language browser task with browser-use, confined to this instance's allowed domains

task.description: What the browser agent should accomplish

allowedDomains.description: Domains this instance may visit; empty allows any
